scope: Original public GitHub Actions ZIP bytes authenticated against provider digests before analysis.
profileRule: Each archive records its own profile. Standard Actions VMs do not establish physical-host exclusivity. Cache observations are a separate experiment.
comparisonRule: Compare timings only within their recorded campaign. Keep failed measurements and diagnostics separate.
privacyScan: High-confidence credential, private-key and signed-URL patterns checked; no private handoff archive read or copied.
rawMetadata: Original archives retain public ephemeral runner names, Docker IDs, system paths and hashed host fingerprints needed to audit the experiment.
